rows.text: SPA, Riyadh 15 Rabi al-Awwal 1446 / 18 September 2024: on behalf of King Salman, the Crown Prince and Prime Minister, Prince Mohammed bin Salman, opened the first year of the Council's ninth term that day, Wednesday, and later delivered the annual royal address on the King's behalf.
rows.locator: Dateline; paragraph 1; closing paragraph before the royal address; trailer 18:11 Makkah time

rows.holder_name: Abdullah bin Mohammed bin Ibrahim Al Al-Sheikh
rows.printed_name: عبد الله بن محمد بن إبراهيم آل الشيخ
rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: The same report says 'معالي رئيس مجلس الشورى الشيخ الدكتور عبد الله بن محمد بن إبراهيم آل الشيخ' received the Crown Prince and then recited the oath before him in the session hall, the members repeating it, before giving the opening speech.
